channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Reviews are in, and Hollywood insiders aren't pleased with the Netflix-Warner Bros. deal
item.description: The deal has raised concerns about job cuts, a lack of competition, and the future of the movie theater industry.

item.title: Think you're smarter than the machines? Test your AI jargon knowledge in our quiz.
item.description: Test your AI knowledge with this jargon quiz covering artificial intelligence, machine learning, and current tech terms used by experts and execs.

item.title: Economists run a secret prediction game each year. When ChatGPT took part, here's what happened.
item.description: The ability to forecast the future is valuable sign of intelligence and a good test of AI's capabilities. Economists put ChatGPT to the test.

item.title: David Zaslav tells employees 'HBO Max will stay' after Netflix deal
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav told employees that "HBO Max will stay" after Netflix buys Warner Bros. and HBO in a media mega-merger.

item.title: How much are Illenium tickets? Vegas Sphere residency dates and prices
item.description: Illenium is on tour around the US and scheduled for a Las Vegas Sphere residency in 2026. Here's where to find tickets for his sold-out shows.

item.title: How to get Ariana Grande tickets: Prices and dates compared
item.description: Though it won't kick off until the summer of 2026, Ariana Grande's coming tour is already sold out. Here's where to find tickets from resellers.

item.title: Vanity Fair and Olivia Nuzzi cut ties as RFK Jr. relationship drama continues to unfold
item.description: Vanity Fair and journalist Olivia Nuzzi are severing ties amid the continued fallout surrounding Nuzzi's relationship with RFK Jr.

item.title: SHRM, the world's largest HR group, has been hit with an $11.5 million verdict in a racial discrimination lawsuit
item.description: A jury found the HR trade organization liable for racial discrimination and retaliation against a former employee.

item.title: Judge orders Google to rebid for default search deals every year in a major antitrust blow
item.description: A federal judge orders Google to limit default search deals to one year, in an antitrust effort to open doors for rivals in search and generative AI.

item.title: Meta delays release of new mixed reality glasses code-named 'Phoenix' in order to 'get the details right'
item.description: Meta plans to release a new wearable device codenamed "Malibu 2" in 2026, according to an internal memo viewed by Business Insider.
